verdicts.summary: Lean has an equivalent formula. Same two moments in the same pairing — weight R^2 against the angular mean v, weight R against the axial mean γ, both of the auxiliary torus average ⟨·⟩_Y. Two rewritings. (i) Range of integration: `pressureMass` integrates r over all of ℝ, not over (0,∞). They agree under the invariant, because its `primitives` field gives `MovingTriple`, hence `MovingField.supported` : for slow points of the carrier the mean fields vanish outside R ∈ [ℓ(s)·a, ℓ(s)·b], and `SignedMeanGain.Geometry.patch.a_pos` gives 0 < a with ℓ(s) > 0, so the integrand vanishes for R ≤ 0. (ii) The Lean identity is stated pointwise in the band index n and the slow variable s ∈ G.region.carrier (`ZeroMassesOn`), where the paper leaves the slow dependence implicit; the unrestricted form is `CorrectionState.ZeroMasses`.
